people.name: Daesung Lee
people.title: Professor
people.bio:
Professor, Dept. of Maritime AI & Cyber Security. Director, Cybersecurity Engineering Research Center.
Research interests: AX Security, Convergence Security, Network Security, Maritime Cybersecurity, ICS Security, Critical Information Infrastructure Protection.

Research Interests
- AX Security, Convergence Security, Network Security
